title: AI YouTube summary Chrome extension at $5/month

source.text: A Chrome extension that summarizes YouTube videos with AI, $5 a month. Launch country US, budget $500, 10 hours a week, goal side income, edge: I am a developer. Just go: do not ask questions.

problem: Watching long YouTube videos takes time; viewers want the content without watching all of it.
solution: A Chrome extension that summarizes YouTube videos with AI.
assumptions: Customer segment not stated: assumed US students and knowledge workers who watch long educational or podcast videos.
Channel not stated: assumed Chrome Web Store search plus organic posts (Reddit, Product Hunt), no paid ads.
Founder time valued at USD 25/hour for the organic CAC estimate.
Freemium model (a few free summaries, then USD 5/month) assumed, like the competitors.
